limitations: No assertion on arbitrary finite groups, odd-characteristic extraspecial groups, or lifting symplectic isometries to group automorphisms; historical-priority searches cannot establish absolute novelty.
scientific_integrity: Theorem proved for all ranks by symplectic Gram matrices, nondegenerate orthogonal splitting and exact orbit and incidence counts. A separate exhaustive checker tests ranks one through three; independent external validation has not been performed.
title: The complete maximum-noncommuting-clique extension spectrum for binary symplectic groups
